intro: CAVA Harissa BBQ Pita Chips bring bold Mediterranean-inspired flavor to your meal with a smoky, spicy twist. These baked pita chips feature harissa BBQ seasoning that delivers the perfect balance of heat and sweetness. At 280 calories with 10g of protein, they make an excellent side for any [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) selection.
priceCalories: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips are priced between $2.75 and $2.95 depending on your location. Each serving contains 280 calories, making them a moderately indulgent side option. With 10g of protein, 43g of carbs, and 10g of fat, these chips offer satisfying crunch and nutrition. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how they fit into your meal plan.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Harissa BBQ Pita Chips apart is the unique fusion of North African harissa spice and classic BBQ flavor. Unlike standard chips, these are baked for a lighter texture while maintaining exceptional crunch. The harissa seasoning adds a distinctive heat that complements CAVA Mediterranean offerings. This flavor profile stands out on the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) as a bold alternative to plain chips.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Harissa BBQ Pita Chips contains 280 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 10g protein, 43g carbohydrates, and 10g fat. The baked preparation method keeps fat content reasonable compared to fried alternatives. These chips provide satisfying energy without overwhelming your meal calorie count. For detailed allergen information, visit the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) page.
whatsInside: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips feature baked pita bread as the base, seasoned with a proprietary harissa BBQ spice blend. The harissa component typically includes chili peppers, garlic, and aromatic spices, while the BBQ seasoning adds smoky sweetness. The baking process creates a crispy texture without excess oil. These simple, quality ingredients deliver maximum flavor in every crunchy bite.
tasteLike: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips deliver an initial smoky-sweet BBQ flavor followed by a warm, building heat from the harissa spices. The pita base provides a slightly nutty, wheat-forward taste that balances the bold seasoning. The texture is satisfyingly crispy with a light, airy crunch. The spice level is noticeable but not overwhelming, making these chips approachable for most palates while still exciting for heat seekers.
customize: While Harissa BBQ Pita Chips come pre-seasoned, you can customize your CAVA experience by pairing them with various [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) options like hummus or tzatziki. Add them to any bowl or pita from the [full CAVA menu](/) for extra crunch. Consider ordering alongside milder items to balance the spice, or double down on heat with spicy proteins and dressings.
pairsWell: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips pair excellently with cooling dips like tzatziki or classic hummus to balance their heat. They complement grilled chicken, spicy lamb meatballs, or falafel from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains). The smoky-spicy flavor works well with fresh vegetable toppings and creamy dressings. Try them with a curated bowl featuring tangy feta and crisp greens for textural and flavor contrast.
healthyChoice: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips offer a healthier alternative to traditional fried chips since they are baked. With 280 calories and 10g of protein per serving, they provide more nutritional value than standard snack chips. The 10g fat content is moderate for a crispy side dish. While the carb content is notable at 43g, these chips can fit into balanced eating when paired with protein-rich mains and fresh vegetables.
howToOrder: Order Harissa BBQ Pita Chips at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by adding them as a side to your bowl or pita. Simply tell the team member you would like the Harissa BBQ Pita Chips, or select them when ordering through the CAVA app or website. They are available individually for $2.75 to $2.95. Consider pairing with cooling dips to balance the spicy kick.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Pita Chips at 280 calories and $2.55-$2.95, Harissa BBQ offers significantly more flavor complexity with similar nutrition. Garlic Ranch Pita Chips share the same calorie count and price but provide a creamy, milder taste profile. Whole Pita has 320 calories at $2.25-$2.55 but offers a softer texture. Harissa BBQ stands out for those seeking bold, spicy flavor with satisfying crunch.
whoShouldTry: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips are perfect for spice enthusiasts who appreciate bold Mediterranean flavors. If you enjoy smoky BBQ with a spicy kick, these chips will delight your taste buds. They are ideal for customers looking to add excitement to their CAVA meal beyond standard sides. Anyone exploring the diverse [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) options should give these unique chips a try.
worthTrying: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips are absolutely worth trying for their distinctive flavor combination that you will not find elsewhere. At $2.75-$2.95, they offer excellent value for a premium baked chip with complex seasoning. The balance of heat, smoke, and crunch elevates any CAVA meal. Whether you are a regular or first-time visitor, these chips provide a memorable taste experience that showcases CAVA commitment to bold Mediterranean-inspired flavors.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Harissa BBQ Pita Chips?
faqs.a: CAVA Harissa BBQ Pita Chips contain 280 calories per serving, with 10g protein, 43g carbohydrates, and 10g fat. They are baked rather than fried, making them a lighter option compared to traditional chips while still delivering satisfying crunch and bold flavor.

faqs.q: How much do Harissa BBQ Pita Chips cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips are priced between $2.75 and $2.95 depending on your location. This makes them a moderately priced side option on the CAVA menu, comparable to other specialty pita chip flavors and offering good value for a premium baked snack.

faqs.q: Are CAVA Harissa BBQ Pita Chips spicy?
faqs.a: Yes, Harissa BBQ Pita Chips have a noticeable spice level from the harissa seasoning, which includes chili peppers and aromatic spices. The heat is moderate and builds gradually, balanced by the smoky-sweet BBQ flavor. Most customers find them flavorful without being overwhelmingly hot.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Harissa BBQ and Classic Pita Chips?
faqs.a: Harissa BBQ Pita Chips feature a bold seasoning blend combining North African harissa spices with smoky BBQ flavor, while Classic Pita Chips have a simpler, more neutral taste. Both contain 280 calories, but Harissa BBQ offers significantly more flavor complexity for those seeking a spicy, adventurous option.

faqs.q: Are Harissa BBQ Pita Chips baked or fried?
faqs.a: CAVA Harissa BBQ Pita Chips are baked, not fried, which makes them a lighter alternative to traditional fried chips. The baking process creates a crispy, crunchy texture while keeping the fat content at a moderate 10g per serving, aligning with CAVA focus on better-for-you Mediterranean options.
